title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
Reed Business Support are seeking an energetic, creative and commercially minded Brand Marketing Manager to take ownership of an established business based in Teesside across their UK and US markets. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building brands, creating engaging content and delivering measurable marketing results.

The successful candidate will drive brand awareness, lead marketing initiatives, manage external marketing partners and identify opportunities for growth. You'll immerse yourself in the business, understand its operations and play a key role in shaping the future direction of their brand.

Working Hours & Benefits

Hours:
- Monday to Thursday: 7:45am - 4:30pm
- Friday: 8:00am - 12:00pm

Hybrid Working:
- Office-based during onboarding.
- Work-from-home Friday mornings available following successful training.

Benefits:
- Paying a competitive salary
- 23 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Free onsite parking.
- Fully equipped facilities.
- Opportunity to make a significant impact within a growing business.

Key Duties:
- Develop and deliver marketing strategies aligned to business goals.
- Strengthen market positioning and drive brand growth.
- Create campaigns that increase awareness, engagement and lead generation.
- Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities.
- Ensure consistent branding across all channels.
- Lead and execute content strategies across digital, social and traditional platforms.
- Produce engaging content showcasing the business, its people, products and services.
- Capture authentic content within operational environments.
- Manage photography, videography, social media content and drone footage assets.
- Coordinate and optimise multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Manage relationships with external marketing providers.
- Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and against objectives.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop effective marketing initiatives.
- Present marketing plans and performance insights to senior leadership.

Candidate Requirements:
- Proven track record of developing and implementing successful marketing strategies.
- Strong brand management and content marketing experience.
- Experience managing multiple marketing channels.
- Exposure to USA markets is advantageous.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.

Personal Attributes
- Energetic, proactive and self-motivated.
- Creative thinker with strong commercial awareness.
- Confident working independently and taking ownership.
- Strong relationship-building skills.
- Passionate about brand growth and business success.

title: Digital Specialist
description:
The Business:
Nigel Wright are delighted to be supporting a leading organisation as they continue to invest in their digital marketing function with the appointment of a Digital Marketing Specialist.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a business that is building more digital capability in-house and placing a strong focus on data-led decision making, customer acquisition, conversion optimisation and emerging AI-driven search opportunities.

The Role:
Reporting into the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in planning, executing and optimising digital acquisition campaigns across a range of channels.

You'll work closely with marketing, digital experience, analytics and external agency partners to improve campaign performance, strengthen customer journeys and increase conversion across key audiences.

This role offers a broad remit, making it ideal for someone looking to develop expertise across performance marketing, SEO, analytics, CRO and AI search optimisation.
The Person:
- Experience in a digital marketing, campaign marketing or performance marketing role
- Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Google Analytics
- Strong understanding of SEO and content optimisation principles
- Experience supporting paid social campaigns
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
- The ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into action
- Strong stakeholder management and organisational skills

You will be able to work dynamically, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, it will give you the opportunity to work across a large-scale marketing function and develop your skills at pace!

title: Marketing Planner
description:
The opportunity
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-profile marketing function at a time of significant growth and transformation. You'll play a central role in shaping how marketing activity is planned, prioritised and delivered, working across multiple teams, channels and audiences.

Sitting at the heart of the marketing operation, you'll help ensure the right projects are being delivered at the right time, bringing structure, coordination and commercial focus to an ambitious marketing agenda.

The role
As Marketing Planner, you'll act as the bridge between the wider business and marketing specialists, translating commercial priorities into clear, actionable marketing plans.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across a variety of functions to coordinate activity, manage priorities and ensure campaigns are delivered effectively. This is a highly visible role that combines planning, project management, stakeholder engagement and performance tracking.

Key areas of focus
- Develop and maintain integrated marketing plans that support business objectives.
- Translate commercial priorities into clear marketing briefs and delivery plans.
- Coordinate activity across multiple marketing disciplines and specialist teams.
- Manage planning schedules, workflows and key project milestones.
- Support campaign planning, prioritisation and resource allocation.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.
- Monitor delivery against plans and provide regular progress updates.
- Identify risks, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Support performance reporting and campaign review processes.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of planning frameworks and ways of working.

About you
You'll be a highly organised marketing professional who thrives on bringing people, projects and priorities together. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, you'll have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to keep multiple workstreams moving forward simultaneously.

We're looking for someone who combines commercial awareness with strong planning discipline, enjoys working collaboratively and can confidently influence across different teams and levels of the business.

You may have experience in marketing planning, campaign management, marketing operations, project management or a similar coordination-focused role where you've been responsible for driving activity from concept through to delivery.

title: PPC & SEO Account Executive
description:
PPC & SEO Account Executive

Hybrid Working Minimum 2 Days Office-Based Mon & Wed
£32,000 - £37,000 per annum
Full-Time, 37 Hours per Week

Are you passionate about paid and organic search? Do you enjoy analysing data, testing new ideas and driving measurable results?

We are looking for a PPC & SEO Account Executive to join our clients growing marketing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded digital marketer who thrives on improving performance, uncovering opportunities, and staying ahead in the ever evolving world of search.

Working closely with the Marketing Lead, you'll take ownership of day-to-day PPC and SEO activity, helping to drive visibility, traffic and conversions across Google, Bing and emerging AI-powered search platforms.

What You'll Be DoingPPC Management

Build, launch and optimise campaigns across multiple advertising platforms, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, OpenAI Ads and Amazon Advertising

Conduct keyword research, create compelling ad copy and manage bids, budgets and campaign performance

Monitor account performance daily, identifying opportunities for growth and optimisation

Run A/B testing across audiences, ad copy and landing pages to improve conversion rates

Maintain account health, including quality scores, tracking, feeds, automations and ad compliance

Analyse campaign data and provide recommendations to maximise ROI

Manage advertising budgets effectively to deliver strong value for money

SEO & Organic Search

Conduct keyword research, mapping and content gap analysis

Optimise website content and landing pages to improve rankings, traffic and conversions

Create and brief engaging content including blogs, FAQs and search-focused resources

Support technical and on-site SEO improvements

Contribute to link-building strategies aligned with industry best practice

Monitor search trends and stay ahead of developments in AI-powered search and evolving customer behaviour

Reporting & Analysis

Produce insightful reports using Google Analytics 4 and platform data

Translate performance metrics into actionable recommendations

Support stakeholder reporting and performance reviews

Act as the day-to-day technical contact for PPC and SEO activity

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:

Minimum 12 months hands-on PPC and/or SEO experience

Experience managing campaigns within Google Ads

Understanding of SEO principles, including keyword research, content optimisation and link-building

Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting performance data

Experience using Google Analytics 4

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities

A commercial mindset and ability to make data-driven decisions

A genuine interest in the future of search and AI technologies

Desirable Experience

Facebook Ads

OpenAI Ads

Amazon Advertising

Looker Studio reporting

Experience within a product-led business environment

What You'll Get In Return

Competitive salary of £32,000 - £37,000

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office

Excellent work-life balance:
- Monday-Thursday: 9:00am - 5:00pm
- Friday: 9:00am - 2:00pm

Smart salary sacrifice pension scheme with 5% employer contribution

Access to professional financial advice

Cycle to Work scheme

Private healthcare scheme

Free on-site parking

Apply Today

If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your digital marketing career within a forward-thinking business and want to play a key role in shaping PPC and SEO performance across both traditional and AI-powered search channels, please apply today.

title: Sales, Finance & Marketing Administrator
description:
Permanent 20-30 hours per week Monday to Friday

£30,000 FTE, pro rata

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Sales, Finance & Marketing Administrator to join our team at Executive Compass.

This is a permanent, office-based role at Hoults Yard in Newcastle, with flexible part-time hours across five days.

You can work between 20 and 30 hours per week, for example:
- 10am-2pm, Monday to Friday
- 9am-3pm, Monday to Friday

or another agreed pattern within those parameters.

This role could suit someone looking for a professional part-time position with predictable weekday hours.

About the role

Executive Compass is an independent bid writing consultancy supporting organisations across the UK to win public and private-sector contracts.

You will join our sales, finance and marketing team and help keep our day-to-day commercial administration accurate, organised and running smoothly.

Your main responsibilities will include:
- maintaining client, enquiry and opportunity records in Salesforce
- setting up new clients and projects
- carrying out company credit checks using Creditsafe
- issuing terms and conditions through Signable
- raising and issuing invoices through Xero
- maintaining accurate spreadsheets and business records
- monitoring outstanding invoices and supporting credit control
- liaising professionally with clients by telephone and email
- providing wider sales, marketing and administrative support.

As the role develops, there may also be opportunities to support outbound marketing, website administration and other commercial activities.

About you

You do not need previous experience of bid writing or tenders.

However, this is not a trainee administration role. We are looking for someone who already has experience working in an office, administration, finance support, sales support or similar business environment.

You should be:
- highly organised
- accurate and detail-focused
- confident using IT and learning new systems
- comfortable working with spreadsheets and business data
- confident communicating with customers by telephone and email
- able to manage your own workload
- proactive and dependable
- comfortable working in a busy professional office.

Experience of Salesforce, Xero or similar CRM/accounting systems would be helpful but is not essential.

Salary and hours

£30,000 full-time equivalent, pro rata according to hours worked.

The role is available for 20-30 hours per week across Monday to Friday.

Typical working patterns could include:
- 20 hours: approximately 10am-2pm
- 30 hours: approximately 9am-3pm

There is some flexibility around exact start and finish times.

Benefits

You will join a friendly and supportive Newcastle-based team and receive:
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, pro rata
- annual leave increasing to 30 days following the qualifying period
- an additional birthday holiday following probation
- annual salary reviews
- opportunities for paid overtime
- fully funded training and development
- opportunities to broaden the role as the business develops
- regular staff social events
- a modern office environment at Hoults Yard.

Location

This role is office based at Hoults Yard, Newcastle upon Tyne.

Applicants must be able to travel reliably to Hoults Yard Monday to Friday.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Reed in Teesside are working with an established business based in Middlesbrough who are looking to appoint a full time, permanent Digital Marketing Executive to join their Sales & Marketing team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone that would like to continue and develop their marketing skills and gain further exposure to different areas of marketing.

Benefits:
- 25 days A/L + BH
- Pension
- Free parking
- Social events
- Annual bonus scheme (company discretion)
- Hours: Monday to Friday - 08:30 - 17:15

Reporting into the Sales & Marketing Manager, you will work as part of a small team where you will be responsible for developing and delivering data-driven marketing campaigns across multiple channels including social media platforms, email, video, SEO and PR. You will be liaising with a third-party agency to support the delivery of company-agreed SEO and PPC strategies.

Duties:
- Lead market research for the brand: analyse trends, competitor activity, and target audience insights
- Create engaging content for social media channels (LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube)
- Manage social media presence: schedule posts, review analytics, and contribute new content ideas
- Identify emerging trends and implement strategies to grow the customer base through lead generation (e.g., LinkedIn Ads, PPC)
- Develop marketing materials, including brochures, infographics, and other collateral
- Create and manage email marketing strategies
- Produce short- and long-form video content
- Plan and execute SEO-focused content strategies, including blogs and other formats
- Apply strong working knowledge of SEO principles
- Develop proficiency in key marketing tools using CRM and Canva
- Use strong organisational skills to plan, create, and deliver key marketing activities
- Create PR-friendly content to support SEO outreach strategies
- Liaise with third-party providers such as SEO/PPC agencies and PR publications
- Act as a positive role model within the business and strive to improve customer satisfaction
- Collaborate with colleagues and managers to deliver exceptional customer service
- Complete industry training and maintain relevant technical knowledge

The person -

This is a B2 B marketing role that relies heavily on creativity, good organisation skills, a keen eye for detail, and an aptitude to promote products and services that generate marketing leads for the Sales team.

If you are:
- Able to work on your own autonomy and part of a small team
- Have previous experience using a CRM system to drive automated marketing campaigns
- Have experience using various Adobe tools and Canva
- Savvy in areas such as generative content through AI
- Have experience creating video content (not essential but desirable)
- Want to progress and learn and further develop your skills and experience
- Can manage a heavy workload and work to tight deadlines
- Follow target driven metrics and follow and execute a marketing plan

Then I want to hear from you Interviews to be held ASAP!

title: Interim Marketing Manager
description:
Interim Marketing Manager (12-Month FTC)

Sedgefield On-site Fixed-Term Contract Starting Early November

We're supporting an innovative, technology-led business in the search for an Interim Marketing Manager to join the team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership of marketing activity across the business, delivering B2 B campaigns, managing digital channels, creating engaging content, supporting product launches, and working closely with commercial and technical teams.

We're particularly interested in candidates with experience in a technical B2 B environment. This could include sectors such as engineering, manufacturing, technology, industrial, scientific, electronics, or other complex product-led businesses. You'll be confident translating technical information into effective marketing campaigns that engage customers and support business growth.

Key Requirements:
- Proven B2 B marketing experience
- Background within a technical, engineering, manufacturing, or technology-led business
- Strong digital marketing and content creation skills
- Experience delivering marketing campaigns that support commercial objectives
- Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation and make an immediate impact during an important period of development.

For further information, please apply or get in touch.
